reasoning: The complete supplied HTML filing was searched, and the confidentiality definition was read in its Annex context. It is between the printed A-47 and A-48 footers, placing it on A-48. The merger-agreement preamble on A-1 resolves both defined parties. This is direct full-filing evidence; it is not an inference from the April 3-6 convention meetings.

E08 and reference.md event 8 say exact individual execution dates are absent without limiting the claim to Background. That statement is too broad given the reported G&W agreement date. The instruction, Part A and C10, and RUBRIC.md require consulting the rest of the filing. The reference cannot override this source-supported date.

The locked T01 weighs 2.5 points and tests coarse early chronology, date precision, and NDA/extra-contact date honesty. It expressly accepts honest bounds/by dates. E08 and C3 permit type cohorts or named entries with net residuals. AM01 changes evidence, not weights, participation counts, cohort alternatives, or the denominator.

The primary grader consistently accepts supported evidence for C, identifies the corresponding individual-row correction for A, and retains the permitted cohort treatment for B. A is already partial for the missing additional contacts and retains useful correct chronology; adding its missed individual date precision does not justify a fail. B and C have no individual G&W date cells requiring tightening.

C10 already requires tightening supported individual dates; it would be inaccurate to imply AM01 creates that instruction for the first time. The unchanged score follows from the existing composite pass/partial/fail test and candidate representations, not from an exemption for A from C10.

C cites page 28 for its cohort quote; that quotation supports the cohort but not the April 3 detail in its Note. The date is nevertheless supported elsewhere in the filing. Add the A-48 source to its evidence trail as a citation refinement, not an invented-date penalty. Likewise, its When phrase after week of 03/28/2016 is loose: it should say following outreach so it cannot be read as excluding April 3, the last day of that week. Its actual lower bound and explicit note include April 3; this wording refinement does not change its T01 credit.

No source-supported rationale from AM01 changes an entry count, process, round, or offer. Other tests, including P02, retain their supplied judgments; this adjudication makes no finding about unrelated grading disputes.

recommended_reference_text: Exact individual NDA dates are generally absent from Background. Annex A-48 defines the Company-Parent Confidentiality Agreement as dated April 3, 2016; A-1 identifies Company as Providence and Worcester and Parent as G&W. Accept this reported agreement date for G&W. An individual G&W NDA row should use April 3 under C10. Type cohorts remain permitted; do not assign April 3 to every cohort member or duplicate G&W as an additional entrant.

affected_tests.reason: Apply the reported individual agreement date consistently while preserving locked composite grading and cohort alternatives.

Candidate-A.reason: Deal ledger!10 (event #9) separately records G&W with When subsequently; by 04/22/2016, Sort date 2016-04-10, and bounds 2016-03-28 through 2016-04-22. April 3 lies within those bounds, so this is missed precision, not a fabricated April 10 execution claim. C10 calls for When, Sort date, Date from and Date to to use April 3 for this individual row, with row order adjusted as needed. The grader already logs this as A-E4. T01 remains partial: the useful Q4/January/March sequence survives, while the by-April-7 additional-contact event is absent. The extra date refinement does not make the composite test wholly incorrect and does not warrant a second free-standing deduction.

Candidate-B.reason: Deal ledger!9-10 (events #8-9) use permitted 11-strategic and 14-financial NDA cohorts. The strategic row includes G&W, has bounds 2016-03-28 through 2016-04-07, and uses April 2 as a sort key. April 3 is inside the interval; April 2 is not asserted as every member's execution date. A known date for one member neither dates the entire cohort nor requires an additional individual row. Deal ledger!11 records the extra contacts as by April 7. AM01 supplies no basis to change the T01 pass.

Candidate-C.reason: Deal ledger!9 (event #8) is the 11-strategic NDA cohort and explicitly notes G&W (NDA dated 04/03/2016). A-48 supports that note. Its March 28 Sort date and Date from, with Date to blank, are cohort ordering/bounds fields, not a March 28 execution claim for G&W. Deal ledger!11 records the extra contacts as by April 7. The April 3 note is neither an invented date nor a reason to split the permitted cohort, so T01 remains pass.
